'''Ben Saunders Save You It Can''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ben Saunders]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls35.htm Save You It Can], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002719/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls35.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
